name: Lugenau
beschreibung: The Lugenau campsite is located in Tirol in a rural setting with views of the Alpen. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking and cycling. The facilities include pitches with electricity and water connections as well as modern sanitary facilities. A small shop offers basic foodstuffs. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature. The site appeals above all to families and older couples. There is no restaurant; guests cater for themselves. Dogs are allowed.
